subject: Marine Works - Pointe-des-Monts to Anticosti - north - Sept-Îles Port
text:
Marine Works - Pointe-des-Monts to Anticosti - north - Sept-Îles Port
Dredging operations taking place daily 24 hours a day at Pier 2 of the Rio Tinto port facilities from 01 Nov to 06 Nov 2026. Dredge, barges, and tugs on site.
